purpose: Independently confirm the frozen PSSB surface effect on completely fresh material while applying a shared actor-visible expression hygiene baseline to both arms and enforcing hard debugging/error-prevention gates before any scoring.

shared_actor_visible_expression_hygiene.facial_expression: Prefer observable eye/gaze/mouth/jaw/brow/breath/posture/tension changes over direct emotion labels.
shared_actor_visible_expression_hygiene.emotion_flow: Expose emotional transition as a sequence of playable visible changes in face, gaze, breathing, hand/object handling, bodily tension, distance, timing, silence, hesitation or interruption, tied to the licensed scene cause/turn/exit state.
shared_actor_visible_expression_hygiene.direct_emotion_naming: DISFAVORED when visible behavior/expression can carry the fact. Allowed only when production clarity requires it and no equivalent playable cue can preserve the licensed fact.
shared_actor_visible_expression_hygiene.anti_overdirection: Do not choreograph every micro-expression. Use only the minimum actor-playable cues needed to make the turn and emotional progression legible.
shared_actor_visible_expression_hygiene.anti_redundancy: Do not have dialogue explicitly verbalize emotion already made legible by expression/action.
shared_actor_visible_expression_hygiene.semantic_safety: No new motive, backstory, event, decision-owner or future-thread may be invented to justify expression.

frozen_arm_difference.CONTROL: R2-repaired surface renderer baseline + shared actor-visible expression hygiene. No PSSB intervention.
frozen_arm_difference.TREATMENT: Byte-identical shared upstream + same shared actor-visible expression hygiene + frozen R3 PSSB only.
frozen_arm_difference.PSSB: Bind already-licensed important scene turns to actor-visible/camera-legible consequence through naturally available action, prop use, blocking, timing, interruption, silence, failed action, bodily effort or spatial change; compress explanatory procedure where action-response can carry required facts; preserve character-specific rhythm and already-licensed causal location/prop use.

generation_scale.attempt_rule: Only prescore scale/structure/hygiene/shared-semantics failures may trigger the second attempt. First prescore-admitted attempt is final. No post-score retry.

masked_sample.U12: whole-episode broadcast surface/craft after full read

independent_confirmation_rule.cross_judge_surface_rule: Each H2 surface-axis median Treatment-Control delta across the three judges >= +0.30.
independent_confirmation_rule.cross_judge_structure_rule: Each protected-axis median delta >= -0.10; adoption NONLOSS.
independent_confirmation_rule.PASS: 2/3 or more judges pass H1-H3, cross-judge H2/H3 medians pass, and H4 remains PASS => PASS__INDEPENDENT_JUDGE_CONFIRMATION__FRESH_HUMAN_VALIDATION_AUTHORIZED.
independent_confirmation_rule.FAIL: Valid scored execution not meeting rule => FAIL__INDEPENDENT_CONFIRMATION_NOT_REPRODUCED.
independent_confirmation_rule.HOLD: Prescore/provider/mask/provenance integrity failure before valid scoring => HOLD.
